description: Repo-scale (express-js-inventory): POST /api/warehouses/:fromId/transfer-items must validate every itemId belongs to the source warehouse BEFORE moving any of them (atomic across two warehouses), plus a destination maxCapacity check
prompts: Warehouses gain an optional `maxCapacity` field (non-negative integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/warehouses and return it in warehouse responses. Add `POST /api/warehouses/:fromId/transfer-items`: body `{"toWarehouseId": N, "itemIds": [...]}`, moving the given items from the source warehouse to the destination. This spans two warehouses and must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY itemId in the request currently belongs to the source warehouse (:fromId) BEFORE moving any of them - if one doesn't, respond 400 and leave every item exactly where it was, not partially transferred; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch's combined quantity into the destination wouldn't push its total over its maxCapacity, again before moving anything. On success, return the moved items with their updated warehouseId.
name: add_js_inventory_transfer_items_atomic
